verdict.rationale: The SDK's own permission system uses modes and rules to auto-allow some tools and routes everything else to a canUseTool callback. That callback receives the tool name and input and pauses execution until the app returns an approval decision, so sensitive calls can be gated selectively. Hooks can also block dangerous operations before they execute. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that approval gating works in practice.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can require human approval before specific sensitive tool calls execute
